landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.q1: Do I need internet for every feature?
landing.faq.a1: No — recent advisories, saved soil plans and your chat history are stored on your phone and work offline.
landing.faq.q2: Is my photo data kept private?
landing.faq.a2: Leaf photos never leave your device in this demo build. In production they're encrypted end-to-end.
landing.faq.a3: English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu and Marathi — the full app, not just menus.
landing.faq.q4: How accurate is the disease detector?
landing.faq.a4: Our training set includes 1.2M labelled leaves. In field trials we hit 95%+ match to agronomist reviews.
landing.faq.q5: Can I use it without a smartphone?
landing.faq.a5: Yes — there's an SMS-based advisory line for feature phones. Ask your cooperative lead.
landing.faq.a6: Starter is free forever. Pro is ₹199/month. Cooperatives can onboard up to 500 farmers for ₹999/month.
landing.faq.q7: Is it available in my state?
landing.faq.a7: Yes — we currently cover all 28 states, with deeper soil data for 12 priority states.
landing.faq.a8: Never. We're funded by paid subscriptions, not ads.
